Piccadilly have represented the Kia Brand since 2006. Today we have one of the most up to date model line ups, including a range of fully electric vehicles, which we are selling from our newly refurbished Dealerships. Our business is built on treating all our customers in the same manner we ourselves would expect to be treated. We also pride ourselves on being ultra-competitive, without compromise on our high standards. Piccadilly Motors represents the Kia Brand from its premises on Boroughbridge Road in Knaresborough, covering Harrogate and the surrounding areas in North Yorkshire. Our other Kia Dealership is on Bradford Road, Wrenthorpe, Wakefield, covering West Yorkshire. The friendly, highly trained teams at both Dealerships will always help with your motoring needs. Piccadilly Motors “A Great Deal Better”, will not be beaten on price and service! As well as offering great deals on the New Kia range, we also have a massive selection of high-quality used cars, which are priced to sell. If you are unable to find what you are looking for, please give us a call, as fresh stock arrives daily. We also offer carefully selected, safe and reliable, lower price cars, from those we take in part exchange, to retail under our Brand Cars2Good2Trade. These are perfect for first time buyers or anyone wanting a less expensive used car that can be driven with confidence. Aftercare service is an important part of our business. Our factory trained technicians, working with the latest technology, supported by our friendly and helpful customer service advisors ensures you and your vehicle are cared for to the highest standards, in an efficient and friendly manner. We are conscious of the need to always keep service pricing competitive, to retain your business. We can also offer Manufacturer backed Service Plans, which allow you to budget and the same time benefitting from low-cost inflation proof pricing. Thank you for visiting our site. Our team look forward to speaking to you or meeting you at one of our Dealerships. C the salesman was fantastic throughout, dealing with my questions and sorting out a way of getting roof-bars on the vehicle which I wanted for my bike rack. Paperwork and admin was all well organised when I came to collect the car, and I was on my way back up to Scotland a happy customer. Thank you Piccadilly Paul F Really very impressed by the sales service we received from Nick at Ripon. We never felt like we were being pressured into buying, it was a very positive experience and we got a great deal on a car we really wanted.
